categories.main_business_segments: Sung Bo Chemicals primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of crop protection products including insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, and related agrochemicals. Additionally, the company engages in rental income from factory and office buildings, operates F&B businesses with multiple cafe locations, and pursues smart farm-based crop research, cultivation, and distribution through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes chemical synthesis and formulation technologies for crop protection products, including insecticides, fungicides, and herbicides. It also develops organic agricultural materials and employs hydroponic cultivation and smart farm technologies, including ICT-based plant factories and vertical farming. Research and development focus on bio-agro materials, formulation development, and advanced cultivation methods such as hydroponics with patented technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are farmers served through wholesale and retail distributors and agricultural cooperatives across South Korea. The company also targets B2B markets for high-value specialty crops via its smart farm subsidiary. The F&B segment targets health-conscious consumers, especially younger demographics, through cafes offering fresh and healthy food products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within South Korea, with production facilities located in Ansan and sales offices distributed nationwide. Its subsidiaries operate in Seoul and Ansan, focusing on urban smart farming and F&B markets. While raw materials are imported from global suppliers such as BASF, Bayer, and Syngenta Korea, the company’s sales and operations are domestically focused.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sung Bo Chemicals operates primarily in the midstream segment of the agricultural supply chain, manufacturing and formulating crop protection chemicals. It also extends downstream through distribution networks to farmers and retail customers. Its smart farm and F&B businesses represent vertical integration efforts, linking production of specialty crops directly to end consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in developing high-quality, effective, and environmentally safe crop protection products, including bio-based and organic materials. It invests in smart farm technologies such as hydroponics and vertical farming to enhance sustainable crop production. Strategic initiatives include diversification into senior care farming (care farms) and F&B sectors, leveraging technology and innovation to create new growth engines.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of crop protection chemicals to wholesalers and retailers. Additional income streams include rental income from leased factory and office spaces, sales from F&B cafe operations, and B2B sales of specialty crops produced via smart farming. The company does not rely on external financing and funds investments through retained earnings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic and international agrochemical firms, including global players like BASF, Bayer, and Syngenta, from whom it sources raw materials. Sung Bo Chemicals maintains a stable market position in South Korea by focusing on product quality, technological development, and expanding into niche markets such as organic and bio-based crop protection products and smart farming.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported annual revenues of approximately 626 billion KRW, with a slight decline of 5.7% compared to the previous year. Operating profit decreased significantly due to increased costs and competitive pricing pressures. The company has a solid asset base of around 1.65 trillion KRW and equity of approximately 1.33 trillion KRW, with a low debt ratio of about 25%, indicating financial stability despite recent profit declines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sung Bo Chemicals emphasizes high-quality, effective, and environmentally friendly crop protection solutions tailored to the Korean agricultural environment. Its integration of advanced R&D, including bio-agro materials and smart farm technologies, differentiates its product offerings. The company also leverages vertical integration through subsidiaries to supply specialty crops directly to consumers, enhancing product traceability and freshness. Its diversification into care farms and F&B sectors further strengthens its unique market positioning.
